project.project_summary: [26.3 Snapshot 7 / April Fools] - Modpack that mainly tries to support snapshots with maximum performance, including Sodium. This includes minimal QoL mods.

version.changelog:
- Added [Particle Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-core), [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin), and [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config)
- Updated [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Fast Noise](https://modrinth.com/mod/zfastnoise)
